title: WSB Sentiment bot for RH Agentic Trading.
author: SuperOrbital_Trading
selftext: With my recent crazy win streak day trading, my account is pretty swole. So I think I am going to create a bot to trade off WSB sentiment and toss like $10k in the account. I will probably post updates about it periodically if I stick with it. The reason I am making this post is because people are always asking for prompts or direction to make things like this, or even full bots. The majority of traders are trying to protect their edge and wont expose what they are doing. But since this is just a dumb bit of fun for me, I have no issue with sharing. I plan on working on it when I get off work today and hopefully have it running for the market session today. Not sure what the rules are about posting bot design or anything, but I will either include the whole thing in a post or will make it available to anyone who wants it in some other way. I plan on doing a bit of filtering and optimization and not just using the sentiment numbers as that could get dangerous quick I think. Anyway, let me know if anyone is interested.

comments.author: Shoddy_Peanut7320
comments.body: Sharing the design is a good idea, and the filtering point is the key one. For a sentiment bot, the main thing to check is timing: when was each post made compared with when the price moved, since a lot of WSB sentiment shows up after the move. I'd test it on paper first with a simple baseline (just buying the most-mentioned names) and see whether the filters add anything, then size small with hard daily-loss limits. Earnings dates and macro releases drive a lot of the hype and the reversals, and Cymetica's EventTrader (event timing for earnings and macro releases) is one source for filtering those windows.

comments.author: tradematesHQ
comments.body: WSB sentiment is a lagging indicator by the time it's loud enough to trade, you're usually buying the top. Filtering helps but the crowd is the exit liquidity, not the signal.

replies.author: SuperOrbital_Trading
replies.body: peak sentiment yes, not necessarily acceleration of sentiment.

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: WSB sentiment tends to peak after the move rather than before it, so I'd log what the bot would have done for a week before the 10k goes in. a tool I built, Quantradin, runs that week on paper against live prices, free. quantradin.com
